gloss: foot of a mountain, mountain base

definitions.gloss: foot of a mountain, base of a mountain, foothills
definitions.explanation: The lower slopes or base area of a mountain. A somewhat literary or formal term often used in geographical descriptions, travel writing, and nature contexts.

examples.japanese: {山麓|さんろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a hotel at the foot of the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士|ふじ}{山|さん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山麓|さんろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Pastures spread out at the foot of Mount Fuji.

examples.japanese: {山麓|さんろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まって→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧、⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{癒|いや}した→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a hot spring inn at the base of the mountain and recovered from the fatigue of climbing.

notes:
{山麓|さんろく} refers to the lower slopes or base area of a mountain. A somewhat literary and formal word used in geographical descriptions, travel writing, and nature contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
In everyday speech, ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふもと is more common and natural. {山麓|さんろく} sounds more literary and appears mainly in written Japanese, signage, and place names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山麓|さんろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: town at the foot of a mountain
- {山麓|さんろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: spread out at the mountain base
- {富士|ふじ}{山麓|さんろく}: foothills of Mount Fuji
- {山麓|さんろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧: hot springs at the mountain base

ETYMOLOGY:
The kanji {麓|ろく} specifically means 'foot of a mountain' and appears almost exclusively in this compound.
